# konnect_metering_plan (Resource)

MeteringPlan Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_metering_plan" "my_meteringplan" {
  billing_cadence = "P1Y"
  currency        = "USD"
  description     = "...my_description..."
  key             = "resource_key"
  labels = {
    key = "value"
  }
  name = "...my_name..."
  phases = [
    {
      description = "...my_description..."
      duration    = "P1Y"
      key         = "resource_key"
      labels = {
        key = "value"
      }
      name = "...my_name..."
      rate_cards = [
        {
          billing_cadence = "P1Y"
          commitments = {
            maximum_amount = "...my_maximum_amount..."
            minimum_amount = "...my_minimum_amount..."
          }
          currency    = "USD"
          description = "...my_description..."
          discounts = {
            percentage = 44.01
            usage      = "...my_usage..."
          }
          entitlement = {
            metered = {
              is_soft_limit = false
              limit         = 2.8
              usage_period  = "P1Y"
            }
          }
          feature = {
            id = "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
          }
          key = "resource_key"
          labels = {
            key = "value"
          }
          name         = "...my_name..."
          payment_term = "in_arrears"
          price = {
            graduated = {
              tiers = [
                {
                  flat_price = {
                    amount = "...my_amount..."
                  }
                  unit_price = {
                    amount = "...my_amount..."
                  }
                  up_to_amount = "...my_up_to_amount..."
                }
              ]
            }
          }
          tax_config = {
            behavior = "exclusive"
            code = {
              id = "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
            }
          }
          unit_config = {
            conversion_factor = "...my_conversion_factor..."
            display_unit      = "...my_display_unit..."
            operation         = "divide"
            precision         = 0
            rounding          = "none"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
  pro_rating_enabled = true
  settlement_mode    = "credit_then_invoice"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `billing_cadence` (String) The billing cadence for subscriptions using this plan. Requires replacement if changed.
- `currency` (String) The currency code of the plan. Requires replacement if changed.
- `key` (String) A key is a semi-unique string that is used to identify the plan. It is used to
reference the latest `active` version of the plan and is unique with the version
number.
Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) Display name of the resource.

Between 1 and 256 characters.
- `phases` (Attributes List) The plan phases define the pricing ramp for a subscription. A phase switch
occurs only at the end of a billing period. At least one phase is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the resource.

Maximum 1024 characters.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels store metadata of an entity that can be used for filtering an entity list or for searching across entity types. 

Keys must be of length 1-63 characters, and cannot start with "kong", "konnect", "mesh", "kic", or "_".
- `pro_rating_enabled` (Boolean) Whether pro-rating is enabled for this plan. Default: true
- `settlement_mode` (String) Settlement mode for the plan. Defaults to `credit_then_invoice` when omitted. possible known values include one of ["credit_then_invoice", "credit_only"]; Default: "credit_then_invoice"

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `deleted_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity deletion date.
- `effective_from` (String) The date and time when the plan becomes `active`. When not specified, the plan
is in `draft` status.
- `effective_to` (String) A scheduled date and time when the plan becomes `archived`. When not specified,
the plan is in `active` status indefinitely.
- `id` (String) ULID (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier).
- `status` (String) The status of the plan. Computed based on the effective start and end dates:

- `draft`: `effective_from` is not set.
- `scheduled`: `now < effective_from`.
- `active`: `effective_from <= now` and (`effective_to` is not set or
`now < effective_to`).
- `archived`: `effective_to <= now`.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity last update date.
- `validation_errors` (Attributes List) List of validation errors in `draft` state that prevent the plan from being
published. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--validation_errors))
- `version` (Number) Plans are versioned to allow you to make changes without affecting running
subscriptions.
Default: 1

Optional:

- `description` (String) Optional description of the resource.

Maximum 1024 characters.

Between 1 and 256 characters.
Not Null
- `rate_cards` (Attributes List) The rate cards of the plan. Not Null (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards))

<a id="nestedatt--phases--rate_cards"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.rate_cards`

Optional:

- `billing_cadence` (String) The billing cadence of the rate card. When null, the charge is one-time
(non-recurring). Only valid for flat prices.
- `commitments` (Attributes) Spend commitments for this rate card. Only applicable to usage-based prices
(unit, graduated, volume). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--commitments))
- `currency` (String) Overrides the containing plan or add-on currency for this rate card. When
omitted, the containing resource currency applies.
- `description` (String) Optional description of the resource.

Maximum 1024 characters.
- `discounts` (Attributes) The discounts of the rate card. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--discounts))
- `entitlement` (Attributes) The entitlement template granted to subscribers of a plan or addon containing
this rate card. Requires `feature` to be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--entitlement))
- `feature` (Attributes) The feature associated with the rate card. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--feature))
- `key` (String) A key is a unique string that is used to identify a resource. Not Null
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels store metadata of an entity that can be used for filtering an entity list or for searching across entity types. 

Keys must be of length 1-63 characters, and cannot start with "kong", "konnect", "mesh", "kic", or "_".
- `name` (String) Display name of the resource.

Between 1 and 256 characters.
Not Null
- `payment_term` (String) The payment term of the rate card. In advance payment term can only be used for
flat prices.
possible known values include one of ["in_advance", "in_arrears"]; Default: "in_arrears"
- `price` (Attributes) The price of the rate card. Not Null (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--price))
- `tax_config` (Attributes) The tax config of the rate card. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--tax_config))
- `unit_config` (Attributes) Unit conversion configuration for the rate card.

Synthesized on read for plans authored with v1 dynamic or package prices:
dynamic prices map to a unit price with a multiply unit config, and package
prices map to a unit price with a divide unit config.

Accepted on create and update only when the UnitConfig feature is enabled on the
deployment; otherwise rejected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--unit_config))

Optional:

<a id="nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--discounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.rate_cards.discounts`

Optional:

- `percentage` (Number) Percentage discount applied to the price (0–100).
- `usage` (String) Number of usage units granted free before billing starts. Only applies to
usage-based lines (not flat fees). Usage is treated as zero until this amount is
exhausted.

### Nested Schema for `phases.rate_cards.entitlement`

Optional:

- `boolean` (Attributes) The entitlement template of a boolean entitlement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--entitlement--boolean))
- `metered` (Attributes) The entitlement template of a metered entitlement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--entitlement--metered))
- `static` (Attributes) The entitlement template of a static entitlement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--entitlement--static))

<a id="nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--entitlement--boolean"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.rate_cards.entitlement.boolean`


<a id="nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--entitlement--metered"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.rate_cards.entitlement.metered`

Optional:

- `is_soft_limit` (Boolean) If soft limit is true, the subject can use the feature even if the entitlement
is exhausted; access remains granted.
Default: false
- `limit` (Number) The amount of usage granted each usage period, in the feature's unit. Usage is
counted against this allowance and the balance resets every usage period. When
`is_soft_limit` is true the subject keeps access after the limit is reached;
otherwise access is denied once the allowance is exhausted.
- `usage_period` (String) The reset interval of the metered entitlement in ISO8601 format. Defaults to the
billing cadence of the rate card.


<a id="nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--entitlement--static"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.rate_cards.entitlement.static`

Optional:

- `config` (String) The entitlement config as a JSON object. Returned when checking entitlement
access; useful for configuring fine-grained access settings implemented in your
own system.
Not Null; Parsed as JSON.



<a id="nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--feature"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.rate_cards.feature`

Optional:

<a id="nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.rate_cards.price`

Optional:

- `flat` (Attributes) Flat price. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--price--flat))
- `free` (Attributes) Free price. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--price--free))
- `graduated` (Attributes) Graduated tiered price.

Each tier's rate applies only to the usage within that tier. Pricing can change
as cumulative usage crosses tier boundaries.

When UnitConfig is present on the containing resource, tier boundaries
(up_to_amount) are expressed in converted billing units. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--price--graduated))
- `unit` (Attributes) Unit price.

Charges a fixed rate per billing unit. When UnitConfig is present on the object,
billing units are the converted quantities (e.g. GB instead of bytes). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--price--unit))
- `volume` (Attributes) Volume tiered price.

The maximum quantity within a period determines the per-unit price for all units
in that period.

When UnitConfig is present on the containing resource, tier boundaries
(up_to_amount) are expressed in converted billing units. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--price--volume))

<a id="nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--tax_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.rate_cards.tax_config`

Optional:

- `behavior` (String) Tax behavior.

This enum is used to specify whether tax is included in the price or excluded
from the price. If not specified, the billing profile is used to determine the
tax behavior. If not specified in the billing profile, the provider's default
behavior is used.
possible known values include one of ["inclusive", "exclusive"]
- `code` (Attributes) Tax code applied to the invoice line item. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--tax_config--code))

<a id="nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--tax_config--code"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.rate_cards.tax_config.code`

Optional:

- `id` (String) ULID (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier). Not Null



<a id="nestedatt--phases--rate_cards--unit_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phases.rate_cards.unit_config`

Optional:

- `conversion_factor` (String) The factor used in the conversion operation.

- For `divide`: `converted = raw / conversionFactor`.
- For `multiply`: `converted = raw × conversionFactor`.

Must be a positive non-zero value.
Not Null
- `display_unit` (String) A human-readable label for the converted unit shown on invoices and in the
customer portal (e.g., "GB", "hours", "M tokens").

Optional. When omitted, no unit label is rendered.
- `operation` (String) The arithmetic operation to apply to the raw metered quantity. possible known values include one of ["divide", "multiply"]; Not Null
- `precision` (Number) The number of decimal places to retain after rounding.

Only meaningful when rounding is not "none". Defaults to 0 (round to whole
numbers).
Default: 0
- `rounding` (String) The rounding mode applied to the converted quantity for invoicing.

Defaults to none (no rounding). Entitlement checks always use the precise
(unrounded) value.
possible known values include one of ["ceiling", "floor", "half_up", "none"]; Default: "none"

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_metering_plan.my_konnect_metering_plan
  id = "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_metering_plan.my_konnect_metering_plan "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
```
